name: F_CP (charged-polar interface contacts, COCOMAPS/CONSRANK)
description: Number of interface residue-residue contacts between charged (C) and polar (P) amino acids: feature F_CP of the COCOMAPS/CONSRANK set of contact descriptors provided by the Oliva group (a contact is a pair of heavy atoms of the two chains within 5 A). The oriented score is the negated count: fewer charged-polar contacts means more physiological.
